fato_historico: 1917: The Russian Empire is formally replaced by the Russian Republic.
energia_do_dia: Today may feel like a gentle revolution within your soul, Aquarius. Much like the transition of old empires into new republics, you might consider shedding outdated structures in your personal life. It is a good time to embrace your autonomy and let your innovative spirit reign supreme as you establish new boundaries for your own inner freedom.
frase_do_dia: True freedom is found when you dare to build your own tomorrow.
significado_numero: A powerful number representing the dawn of new beginnings and inner light.
conselho: Trust your vision and permit yourself to start fresh with a bold heart.
